# LabGoblin instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md`, `AI_CONTEXT.md`, and `docs/brand.md`. This is classroom infrastructure software branded as **LabGoblin — Virtual Lab Provisioning & Management**. Use LabGoblin for all new user-facing text and treat Proxmox VE as an infrastructure integration, not the product name. Preserve compatibility-sensitive legacy deployment identifiers unless a documented migration exists. Default-deny tenant access, persist every Proxmox mutation as a durable operation, require previews for destructive actions, keep secrets server-side, use linear Alembic migrations, regenerate the OpenAPI contract, and update the wiki with behavior changes. Never claim that mocks validate a live Proxmox deployment.
